# Everything Agent

This agent is designed to handle any task without restrictions. It should be selected whenever it is expected to perform better than the default agent.

## Example Prompts
- "Upgrade all dependencies."
- "Generate documentation for the project."
- "Review the code in this repository."
- "Refactor the codebase for performance."

## Notes
- No tool restrictions.
- No domain or job scope limitations.
- Use as a general-purpose, fallback, or experimental agent.
